# Dixo

> Dixo is a free-to-play online multiplayer implementation of Liar's Dice (Perudo),
> playable in a browser with no download required. 2 to 6 players bluff and bid
> on hidden dice rolls; the last player with dice wins.

## Key pages

- [How to play](https://dixo-game.com/how-to-play): Full rules, Paco (wild die) mechanics, game modes, and ELO ranking explanation.
- [Pricing](https://dixo-game.com/pricing): Free plan vs. Dixo Premium (4.99 EUR/month).
- [Leaderboard](https://dixo-game.com/leaderboard): Live global ELO rankings for 1v1 and 4-player formats.
- [Ranks](https://dixo-game.com/ranks): ELO tier descriptions (Bronze through Diamond).
- [Tournaments](https://dixo-game.com/tournaments): Automated tournaments twice daily, 8 players, single elimination.
- [Training](https://dixo-game.com/training): Practice against AI bots before playing ranked.
- [Skins](https://dixo-game.com/skins): Dice skin catalog and customization.

## About

- Game: Liar's Dice / Perudo — classic bluffing dice game digitized for online play
- Players per game: 2 to 6
- Dice per player: 5 (standard) or 1 (Paco-only final round)
- Game modes: Normal (unranked), Ranked (ELO-based), Private (invite code)
- ELO system: Dual tracking — separate ratings for 1v1 and 4-player formats, starting at 1,000
- Premium: 4.99 EUR/month — GIF avatars, full ELO history, Premium badge
- Platform: Web browser only, mobile-friendly PWA
- Languages: English, French, Spanish
